title: Optica manifest, version 1: common part
description: What every manifest has (see core/MANIFEST.md). Each viewer has its own schema, <viewer>/manifest.schema.json, that refers to this one and adds its fields.

viewer.description: The viewer that reads the manifest (depthoptica...)

unit.description: Unit of every physical value of the manifest (pixel sizes, heights, z, calibration)

angleUnit.description: Unit of every angle of the manifest, required by the viewers that have angles

thumbnails.description: Folder of the thumbnails, named like their image

file.description: Path of a file, relative to the folder of the object

size.description: Size of the images in pixels

pixelSize.description: [x, y] size of a pixel in the unit of the manifest

optionalPixelSize.description: null: the images aren't calibrated, positions are in pixels

acquisition.description: Fields of every acquisition. A viewer schema adds its own and closes it with unevaluatedProperties.

image.description: Fields of every image of images or standaloneImages. A viewer schema adds its own and closes it with unevaluatedProperties.

pixelSize.description: Overrides the pixel size of the acquisition
